value.name: enter building past hesitant panel
value.description: Asha passes through the entrance despite noticing the second panel hesitate mechanically.
evidence: she registered the small mechanical hesitation of the second panel and crossed under it anyway
Inside, the air changed—warmer, faintly medicinal—and she let it close behind her without turning to look at the car

value.name: request administrator and discharge addendum
value.description: At reception, Asha gives her name and her father's name and asks for the administrator handling the MDS-discharge addendum.
evidence: At the reception desk Asha gave her name and her father's, and asked for the administrator who handled the MDS-discharge addendum

value.name: wait for administrator
value.description: The receptionist tells Asha it will be a few minutes before the administrator is available.
evidence: The woman behind the counter glanced up, then down at her screen, and said it would be a few minutes

value.name: receive Rosa's advice
value.description: Asha reads a message from Rosa advising her to ask for the nursing notes instead of relying on forms.
evidence: Her phone buzzed once against her hip, and when she looked at it Rosa's message was waiting: ask them for the nursing notes since last month, they'll tell you more than the forms ever will
She read it twice and slid the phone back into her coat

value.name: request nursing notes
value.description: Following Rosa's advice, Asha asks to see the nursing notes from the past month.
evidence: when the receptionist looked up again Asha added, evenly, that she would also like to see the nursing notes from the past month

value.name: sit and wait with bag in lap
value.description: Asha sits in the waiting area, keeping her bag on her lap and holding the strap tightly.
evidence: Asha sat in one of the upholstered chairs along the wall and kept her bag on her lap, the strap still in her hand

value.name: begin note-taking investigation
value.description: After waiting, Asha opens her notebook and starts organizing her father's history by year and memory.
evidence: After a few minutes in the chair Asha set the bag flat on her thighs, drew out the small notebook she carried for client intake, and uncapped her pen
